summary: Represents a person or entity with an image or fallback initials.
whenNotToUse: As the only identifier: show the name alongside when space allows.

props.name: name
props.description: Person's name: accessible name and source of the initials.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL; on error the initials are shown.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Alternative content to the initials (e.g. an icon).

props.name: isDecorative
props.description: Hides the avatar from assistive technologies when the name is already written next to it.

props.name: AvatarGroup.max
props.description: Maximum number visible; the rest becomes “+N”.

accessibility: The “+N” counter has a localized name (“N more”).
The fallback color is derived deterministically from the name: it carries no information.
responsive: Fixed sizes for optical alignment; choose size based on context.
commonMistakes: Repeating the name twice for screen readers: use isDecorative when the text is next to it.
